title: From Broke to Millionaire at 26 | Money Mindsets with Afnan Khalifa
description:
In this powerful episode, Afnan Khalifa (https://www.instagram.com/theafnankhalifa/?hl=en) shares her inspiring journey from humble beginnings to becoming a symbol of confidence, faith, and financial freedom. She opens up about lessons from her early jobs, how she embraced her voice, and the mindset shifts that transformed her life. Whether you're building your brand or navigating love and money, this one is full of real talk and raw gems.

00:00:00 A Journey to Wealth
00:06:38 Lessons from Working in Restaurants  
00:12:55 Embracing  Confidence
00:19:13 Life's Challenges and Successes
00:25:01 Learning to Trust the Process  
00:31:25 Trusting God's Plan 
00:37:33 The Importance of Building a Personal Brand
00:43:35 Financial Expectations in Relationships
00:50:05 Financial Independence for Women
